rob_001: You can recognise it by its six-metre trunk, broken into surviving fragments rather than one whole column. It stands below the Spitalbastei, beside the town wall at the Muhlacker.
rob_002: You can recognise it as the lime standing roadside beside the Fuchsmuhle guesthouse. It stands on the Taubertalweg, two kilometres downstream of the town walls.
rob_003: You can recognise it as the lime standing by the Langenmuhle mill. It stands on the Taubertalweg, 2.3 kilometres downstream of the town walls.
rob_004: You can recognise them as the two spruces standing together over a small waterfall, in a narrow wooded valley. They stand in the Vorbachtal, near the hamlet of Vorbach.
